title: 彭博：霍尔木兹海峡油轮缓慢通过，LNG运输完全停止
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Now, continuing with the straight of her moves, it remains under intense pressure after the biggest wave of attacks on commercial shipping since the U.S.-Aaron peace deal took
segments.zh: 现在，霍尔木兹海峡局势持续紧张，自美以和平协议生效以来，商业航运遭遇最大规模袭击。

segments.en: effect. Oil tankers continue to trickle through, but many operators are reassessing routes as security concerns intensify.
segments.zh: 油轮仍在缓慢通过，但许多运营商因安全担忧重新评估航线。

segments.en: For more on that story, we're now joined by Steven Stepchinsky, who leads our energy coverage out of Asia.
segments.zh: 更多详情，我们连线亚洲能源报道负责人史蒂芬·斯特普钦斯基。

segments.en: Steven, good to have you on. Look at the situation in the straight of her moves.
segments.zh: 史蒂芬，欢迎。看看霍尔木兹海峡的情况。

segments.en: Are we going to see ships start to tread with even more caution going forward?
segments.zh: 未来船只是否会更加谨慎通行？

segments.en: And just how serious do you think operators are taking the latest developments out of the region?
segments.zh: 运营商对最新事态有多重视？

segments.en: Yeah, I think certainly caution is the name of the game.
We have seen a pretty noticeable decrease in traffic through the straight of her moves.
segments.zh: 我们看到霍尔木兹海峡的交通量明显下降。

segments.en: That being said, there is a trickle still going on. There are some oil tankers going through on the Omani route.
segments.zh: 不过仍有少量油轮通过阿曼航线。

segments.en: Usually these ships are laden. We're seeing fewer empty ships going through the other way.
segments.zh: 通常这些船是满载的，反向空船较少。

segments.en: But still, there are some vessels making the move via both routes.
segments.zh: 但仍有船只通过两条航线通行。

segments.en: I think one thing that has been somewhat noticeable is that there's been, at least as far as I've seen, a total stop to liquefied natural gas traffic through the straight.
segments.zh: 值得注意的是，据我所知，液化天然气运输已完全停止通过该海峡。

segments.en: So an LNG tanker was struck early Tuesday.
segments.zh: 周二早间，一艘液化天然气油轮遭袭。

segments.en: It was a Katari vessel. Katari is the world's second largest LNG exporter.
segments.zh: 那是一艘卡塔尔船只，卡塔尔是全球第二大液化天然气出口国。
